Ignore cars behind you; never move aside for them.
Change lanes ONLY to overtake when you are BLOCKED (a SLOW car CLOSE ahead in your lane). A legal lane is only useful when it gives at least 4 patches more forward distance than your current lane, or is OPEN while your current lane is not OPEN. Never change merely because a lane is legal. Pick an adjacent lane that is OPEN or whose nearest car is fast or far; NEVER move into a lane that also has a slow car close ahead, and never cut into a lane where a fast car is close behind. If both sides qualify, choose the larger forward gap; if the gap advantage is similar, prefer the lane closer to the centre (lane 4). If no legal adjacent lane has this minimum gap gain, accelerate.
If you are blocked and neither side qualifies, ease off briefly and wait for a gap.
